theme: Graphite GPU backend and Skia m152
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings and updates Skia to Chrome milestone m152.
highlights_body: It brings Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn Graphite bindings, a backend-neutral async pixel-read API, a new Silk.NET Vulkan package, and fixes several native use-after-free and memory leaks.

bullets.lead: Skia updated to Chrome milestone m152
bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine to m152, following upstream m151 stability and bug-fix merges.
Adds bindings for Skia's next-generation Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
SKImage and SKSurface gain an async RequestReadPixels API that works consistently across GPU backends.

bullets.lead: New Vulkan Silk.NET package and Nano Server font support
bullets.detail: Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux, and Nano Server now gets font rendering via FreeType.

bullets.lead: Fixed native use-after-free and memory leaks
bullets.detail: Roots the owning object for SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* to prevent native use-after-free, and fixes a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in the SKImage.Create raster failure path.

bullets.lead: Reduced interop overhead in several hot paths
bullets.detail: Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check, avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map, and optimizes SKData.SaveTo to skip a double buffer copy.
Initializes the MSVC environment once per native build instead of repeatedly, and stops pinning a Windows SDK version by default.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Fixed the MSVC environment to initialize once per native build on Windows.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.

harfbuzz_summary: Converts all .sln solutions to the new .slnx format and makes binding generation deterministic across platforms, both of which cover the HarfBuzzSharp binding build.
